use_case_summary: Fairwind operates a mid-size marketplace (3–5M SKUs) selling seasonal apparel and gear. Primary objective: replace heuristic keyword search + business rules with semantic embeddings + two-stage reranking to improve conversion on top-K slots while cutting down manual rules. Key constraints: maintain sub-150ms frontend latency on first page under normal load, keep cost-per-query <$0.003 on average, and support 8–10x traffic bursts during Black Friday/Cyber week. They want model fallbacks, prefix/KV caching, and per-route billing visibility.
crm_notes:
- SLA/latency: P50 target 40-80ms for first-page results, P95 budget 150-200ms for normal traffic. Holiday burst planning required.
- Indexing scale: planned 3–5M dense vectors, incremental updates every 4 hours for inventory + prices. Concern about index rebuild time windows.
- Cost concerns: "can't let inference triple during Nov" (quote from VP Eng). Looking for cost controls: batching, quantization suggestions, dynamic routing to cheaper variants for long-tail queries.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for keys, audit logs with 1 year retention, EU data residency for EU storefronts.
- Preferred models: open weights preferred (llama-family quantized), will test Redwood-verified small reranker + hosted embedding model.
- POC scope: ingest 5M items, run A/B on homepage (current CTR -> target +6%), run 3 traffic patterns including 10x surge.
- Notes on operations: platform team wants per-route cost & latency dashboard and rollback/automatic fallback for cold starts.
- Quotes/asks: "show us token-level cost delta for reranker vs simple BM25 + embed-score"; request for a sample billing export and simulated holiday invoice.
- Next immediate: Diego to schedule Dedicated pilot cluster provisioning week of 2026-03-08; Redwood to provide cost-per-query modeling and a runbook for on-prem connector.
